title: Combating eukaryotic and prokaryotic harmful algal blooms with visible-light driven BiOBrxI1−x/MFe2O4/g-C3N4 (M = Co & Ni) recyclable photocatalysts
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00955J, Paper
Anjitha A, Shijina K, Ajayan K. V., Sindhu Swaminathan, Irene M. C. Lo, Kishore Sridharan
Visible light driven degradation of harmful algal blooms in the presence of synthesized heterojunction photocatalysts showcasing their complete rupture and the photocatalyst's superior efficiency and recyclability is demonstrated in this study.
